verdict.rationale: Runpod ships an official open-source CLI (runpodctl) documented for managing pods, serverless endpoints, templates, volumes, and models, and this was independently verified working at runtime (installed via brew, ran keylessly, version and help output confirmed). This is a strong, corroborated case of an official CLI supporting agentic/AI-native workflows (e.g., 'Run Python functions on remote GPUs directly from your local terminal'). Missing for 10: no deeper hands-on exploration of advanced CLI subcommands or agent-specific CLI usage beyond the smoke test.
